'''Fiona''' is a female NPC working at the [[Vault Underground]]. She can be found gossiping with a male NPC employee, '''Titus'''.

==Quests and Events==
{{Quests and Events}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Fiona''': Heard the latest? Another one's tried to make off with the "secret cache."
:'''Titus''': After all these years, you'd think one of them would actually succeed. Honestly, I'm a bit curious myself about what it actually is.
:'''Titus''': The Montelli family's most scandalous secret? Something like... Lady Carlotta was actually born to a Fisalia, but her Resonance abilities got her sent to the Montellis!
:'''Fiona''': Ugh... you imagination is something else.
:'''Fiona''': But you reminded me of a tale. Years ago, the Vault had a legendary employee. The loan manager pulled the funding on his family business and ruined him. The man vowed vengeance against the Vault itself after that. 
:'''Fiona''': I heard he vowed to pay back the man who did that to him a hundredfold, come hell or high water.
:'''Fiona''': Maybe the "secret cache" is his way of finally getting even?
{{Dialogue End}}
